text:
Priya Rao: Heads-up — candidate for 4pm onsite got delayed at the airport, ETA ~30-40m. Can we swap panel slots? Need a quick rubric clarification too.
Samir Patel: I can cover 4pm if someone can take my 2pm panel. Remote ok?
Aisha Chen: I can move my 2pm -> 3:30pm slot and take Samir's if that helps. Do we still weigh system design higher for senior infra roles?
Ben Kline: For senior infra we usually do: system design 50%, debugging/alg 25%, communication/fit 25%. But recent ask from hiring mgr wanted a slight bump to system design.
Priya Rao: Thanks Ben — can we confirm final weights so debriefs are consistent? Also need permission to record and to send transcript to hiring mgr.
Aisha Chen: Confirming 55% system design, 25% debugging, 20% communication. Recording ok but candidate consent required — we have consent on file?
Ben Kline: Checking — candidate gave verbal consent earlier, but not written. Best to ask again at start of call.
Samir Patel: I'll jump in at 4pm (remote). Priya, can you update calendar and change virtual room to the backup link? New room: https://meet.redwood.ai/backup-4pm
Priya Rao: Updated calendar, moved Samir in, set room to backup link, pinged interviewers. ops-bot: Calendar updated: 4pm slot assigned to Samir Patel; 2pm remains assigned.
Priya Rao: Quick debrief template for everyone — paste into notes after interview:
```
- Strong technical (Y/N)
- System design depth (1-5)
- Debugging/problem solving (1-5)
- Communication & collaboration (1-5)
- Fit notes (2-3 bullets)
- Recommend to move forward? (Yes/No)
```
Aisha Chen: LGTM. Also flag any question that caused major confusion so we can calibrate the rubric later.
Ben Kline: If anyone records, please upload transcript to the candidate folder and add a note about consent.
Priya Rao: Great — I'll remind interviewers at start and flag the rubric weights in the debrief form. Thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder set: "Ask candidate for recording consent" — will notify interviewer at meeting start.
